hub.headline: OGRE is an open-source C++ rendering engine that hides the differences between graphics APIs.
hub.next: Point readers to the OGRE maintainers and record a repeatable source build with its backend choices.
hub.what_it_was: OGRE is a modular C++ rendering backend that sits on top of Vulkan, Direct3D and OpenGL. It runs on Windows, Linux, macOS, Android and iOS.
hub.what_survives: OGRE is alive and its source is public on GitHub under the MIT licence. Versions before 1.7 were LGPL, and the official licensing page keeps that history.

name: OGRE
summary: Public records now track OGRE's source repository, rendering-backend role, platform/API coverage, and MIT licensing record.
